info.description: Curated read-only operations available to a passkey-authenticated browser SPA. All requests use credentials: include. The endpoint allowlist is enforced by the audited g8e-adapter; builders must not call non-allowlisted routes. mTLS producer endpoints are excluded (ensemble-internal).
info.title: g8e Observe Browser API

servers.description: Gateway base URL from runtime config

x-models._comment: Canonical typed payloads for the observability dashboard event families. These are the data payloads carried inside SessionEventWire or BackgroundEventWire envelopes for the four dashboard event types: app.agent.status.updated, app.run.status.updated, ai.eval.run.completed, and ai.eval.metric.recorded. Producers emit these only after the corresponding state projection is persisted. All models exclude null fields on the wire.

agent_state_projection._description: Current lifecycle state of a single agent persona in the roster. Combines the static persona registry projection with the current agent-state snapshot.

agent_id.description: Stable agent identifier matching the persona registry

model.description: Model identifier when the agent is configured with a model

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last status observation

role.description: Agent role or persona (e.g. triage, sage, dash, auditor, warden, scribe, judge)

run_id.description: Owning run identifier when the agent is bound to a run

task_id.description: Active task identifier when the agent is executing a task

throughput.description: Tokens-per-second measurement. Unavailable until a real measured source exists.

agent_status_updated_payload._description: Payload for app.agent.status.updated events. Reports the current lifecycle state of a single agent persona. Distinct from app.agent.activity.recorded, which is a governed document update for AgentActivityMetadata.

model.description: Model identifier when the agent is configured with a model

role.description: Agent role or persona (e.g. triage, sage, dash, auditor, warden, scribe, judge)

run_id.description: Owning run identifier when the agent is bound to a run

task_id.description: Active task identifier when the agent is executing a task

bundle_artifact_entry_wire._description: Wire type mirroring the Python BundleArtifactEntry model. Each entry enumerates a single file beneath the bundle root with its media type, privacy class, canonical SHA-256 hash, byte length, semantic record identity, record count, and optional encryption metadata for restricted artifacts.

byte_length.description: Byte length of the artifact content

media_type.description: IANA media type of the artifact content

path.description: Rooted relative path beneath the bundle root

record_count.description: Number of records for JSONL files

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact content (64-char hex)

bundle_manifest_wire._description: Wire type mirroring the Python BundleManifest model. The immutable, versioned bundle manifest enumerating every included artifact. The publication path reads this as a typed input from the verified bundle; it does not recompute canonical analysis.

artifacts.description: Every included artifact, sorted by path in canonical form

checksum_root_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical checksum root bytes

external_references.description: Content-addressed references to artifacts outside the bundle

manifest_content_sha256.description: SHA-256 over canonical manifest bytes with this field empty

run_id.description: Run identity from the run manifest

download_artifact._description: An allowlisted generated public-safe artifact in the download catalog. Has fixed content type, byte size, SHA-256 hash, privacy classification, and authenticated download URL.

artifact_id.description: Stable artifact identifier used in the download URL path

download_url.description: Authenticated download URL path relative to the Gateway base URL

privacy_classification.description: Disclosure classification. Only public_safe artifacts appear in the browser catalog.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact content for integrity verification

source_run_id.description: Run that produced this artifact when applicable

eval_detail._description: Typed eval detail projection with manifest-safe identity, arm/model information, aggregate metrics, status, and verification boundary.

model_id.description: Model identifier from the manifest role-to-model mapping. Omitted when not available.

model_provider.description: Model provider from the manifest. Omitted when not available.

eval_metric_recorded_payload._description: Payload for ai.eval.metric.recorded events. Reports a single registered metric value with its population, denominator, and verification status.

eligible.description: Number of eligible items in the measured population

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp when the metric was recorded

verification_status.description: Honest verification boundary label. Never 'verified' until the complete verifier exists.

eval_metric_summary._description: A single registered metric in an eval detail projection.

eval_run_completed_payload._description: Payload for ai.eval.run.completed events. Emitted only after the eval projection is persisted. Reports terminal aggregate counts and the verification boundary of a completed eval run.

assigned_tasks.description: Number of tasks assigned to the run

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the eval run completed

published_projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the persisted disclosure-safe projection

receipt_count.description: Number of receipts in the report

terminal_attempts.description: Number of attempts that reached a terminal state

verification_status.description: Honest verification boundary label. Never 'verified' until the complete verifier exists.

eval_summary._description: Paginated eval run projection. Uses manifest role-to-model mappings and registered metrics with honest verification labels.

metric_count.description: Number of registered metrics in the projection

published_projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the persisted disclosure-safe projection. Omitted when no projection is published.

verification_status.description: Honest verification boundary label. Never 'verified' until the complete verifier exists.

evidence_encryption_wire._description: Wire type mirroring the Python EvidenceEncryption model. Restricted artifacts carry encryption metadata; public artifacts do not.

aad_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the additional authenticated data

evidence_safe_link._description: An evidence-safe link in a run detail projection. Links to allowlisted download artifacts only; never exposes restricted prompts, model outputs, or governed evidence.

artifact_id.description: Download artifact identifier in the allowlisted catalog

label.description: Human-readable label for the evidence artifact

external_reference_wire._description: Wire type mirroring the Python ExternalReference model. A content-addressed reference to an artifact outside the bundle.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the external content (64-char hex)

layer_result_wire._description: Wire type mirroring the Python LayerResult model. The result of one verification layer.

failure_count.description: Number of failures produced by this layer

passed.description: True when the layer produced zero failures

observe_bootstrap_snapshot._description: One bounded initial snapshot for first paint. Contains agents, active run, overview counters, recent runs, latest eval summaries, measurements, and download metadata. SSE provides incremental change notifications after the snapshot.

active_run.description: Currently active run for the authenticated user. Omitted when no run is active.

agents.description: Agent roster with current state snapshots

latest_evals.description: Bounded list of latest eval summaries

recent_runs.description: Bounded list of recent run summaries

observe_page._description: Pagination wrapper for paginated observe API responses. Uses stable cursors and bounded page sizes.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Omitted when there are no more results.

items.description: Page items. The item type depends on the endpoint (run_summary, eval_summary, download_artifact).

limit.description: Page size applied to this response

observe_producer_agent_state_request._description: Typed request body for the mTLS producer endpoint POST /api/v1/observe/producer/agent-state. Carries AgentStatusUpdatedPayload fields plus the SSE routing target (exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id). The gateway derives user_id from the mTLS peer certificate, never from the request body.

agent_id.description: Stable agent identifier. The ensemble constructs this deterministically from user_id and persona_id to ensure cross-user uniqueness in the projection document key.

cli_session_id.description: SSE routing target for CLI sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

display_name.description: Human-readable agent name from the persona registry

model.description: Resolved model identifier. May be empty before model resolution.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the state change from the ensemble's own clock

run_id.description: Owning run identifier when the agent is bound to a run

task_id.description: Active task identifier when the agent is executing a task

web_session_id.description: SSE routing target for browser sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

observe_producer_download_artifact_input._description: One entry in the publication request's download catalog. Carries the artifact metadata and base64 content for a single public-safe artifact. Restricted artifacts are never transmitted; only public_safe artifacts appear in the download catalog.

artifact_id.description: Stable artifact identifier used as the document key and download path

byte_size.description: Byte length of the artifact content

filename.description: Human-readable filename for the download disposition header

media_type.description: IANA media type of the artifact content

privacy_classification.description: Disclosure classification. Only public_safe artifacts appear in the download catalog.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact content (64-char hex)

observe_producer_eval_publication_reques._description: Typed request body for the mTLS publication endpoint POST /api/v1/observe/producer/eval-publication. Carries the verified bundle manifest, the verification report, the eval projection fields extracted from the canonical analysis by the publisher, and the download catalog with base64 content for public-safe artifacts. The gateway derives user_id from the mTLS peer certificate, never from the request body. The request carries no user_id field; unknown identity fields are rejected.

arm_id.description: Eval arm identity from the canonical analysis

assigned_tasks.description: Number of assigned tasks in the eval run

bundle_id.description: Unique bundle identity from the manifest

bundle_manifest.description: Typed bundle manifest from the verified bundle

cli_session_id.description: SSE routing target for CLI sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

downloads.description: Download catalog with base64 content for public-safe artifacts

metrics.description: Registered metric rows from the canonical analysis

model_id.description: Model identifier from the canonical analysis, absent if unresolved

model_provider.description: Model provider from the canonical analysis, absent if unresolved

receipt_count.description: Number of receipts in the verified bundle

suite_id.description: Eval suite identity from the canonical analysis

suite_version.description: Eval suite version from the canonical analysis

terminal_attempts.description: Number of terminal attempts in the eval run

verification_report.description: Typed verification report from verify_bundle. ok must be true to publish with the verified status.

web_session_id.description: SSE routing target for browser sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

observe_producer_response._description: Typed response body for the mTLS producer endpoints. Carries a single accepted flag indicating the gateway accepted and persisted the projection. Contains no record identifiers, ownership fields, or echo of the request payload.

accepted.description: Whether the gateway accepted and persisted the projection

observe_producer_run_state_request._description: Typed request body for the mTLS producer endpoint POST /api/v1/observe/producer/run-state. Carries RunStatusUpdatedPayload fields plus the SSE routing target. The gateway derives user_id from the mTLS peer certificate, never from the request body.

cli_session_id.description: SSE routing target for CLI sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

completed_tasks.description: Number of completed tasks in this run

ended_at.description: Run end timestamp for terminal states

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the state change from the ensemble's own clock

run_id.description: Stable run identifier. For investigation runs, this is the investigation_id.

total_tasks.description: Total number of tasks in this run

web_session_id.description: SSE routing target for browser sessions. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is required.

observed_measurement._description: Shared typed measurement shape for displayed resource and throughput values. Every displayed measurement uses a typed value with source and observation time. Resource and throughput cards remain unavailable until real instrumentation exists.

window_seconds.description: Sampling window duration in seconds when applicable

overview_counters._description: Bounded overview counters for the dashboard header. Each counter carries a freshness label so the frontend can show stale or unavailable states honestly.

agents_running.description: Count of agents in active states as defined by the projection contract

success_rate.description: Aggregate success-rate measurement with metric ID, version, denominator, and verification status. Omitted when no eval or run aggregate exists.

tasks_in_queue.description: Count of tasks awaiting execution. Queue semantics are defined by the projection contract, not inferred from incomplete replay history.

overview_measurements._description: Resource and throughput measurements for the dashboard. Each card uses ObservedMeasurement with explicit status. Cards remain unavailable until a real host telemetry collector exists.

cpu.description: Host CPU utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

disk.description: Host disk utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

ram.description: Host RAM utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

total_throughput.description: Aggregate tokens-per-second across matching windows and units. Omitted when no measured source exists.

vram.description: GPU VRAM utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

run_detail._description: Typed run detail projection with tasks and evidence-safe links. Owned by the authenticated user.

evidence_safe_links.description: Evidence-safe links to allowlisted download artifacts

run_status_updated_payload._description: Payload for app.run.status.updated events. Reports the current lifecycle state of a run across investigations, evals, demos, and workflows.

ended_at.description: UTC timestamp when the run reached a terminal state

started_at.description: UTC timestamp when the run started

total_tasks.description: Total number of tasks in the run

run_summary._description: Paginated read-only run summary owned by the authenticated user. Uses stable run IDs, kinds, timestamps, terminal status, and evidence/receipt indicators.

evidence_count.description: Number of evidence-safe artifacts associated with the run

has_receipts.description: Whether the run has at least one governance receipt

run_task._description: A single task within a run detail projection.

owning_agent.description: Agent identifier owning this task when assigned

verification_failure_wire._description: Wire type mirroring the Python VerificationFailure model. One typed verification failure with stable code, layer, and record identity.

layer.description: Verification layer that produced the failure

message.description: Human-readable detail. Not for parsing; the code is the stable contract.

record_id.description: Protected-record identity, empty if not record-specific

verification_report_wire._description: Wire type mirroring the Python VerificationReport model. The typed deterministic verification report. ok is true only when every layer passed with zero failures. The publication path requires ok=true to publish with the verified status; a receipt-only or partial verification cannot produce it.

bundle_id.description: Bundle identity from the manifest, empty if unreadable

failures.description: All failures sorted by layer, record ID, and code

ok.description: True only when every layer passed with zero failures

release_version.description: Release version from the manifest, empty if unreadable

run_id.description: Run identity from the manifest, empty if unreadable
